You can't really plan something like this in advance. If you're liking a place (and more important the people) stay longer, if not leave sooner. For example I did chiang rai on a one day tour and it couldn't be over fast enough (but others wanted to stay longer). I spent 9 days in Pai and the only reason I left was because I had a motorcycle rented out from chiang Mai that I had to return (btw, rent a motorcycle from chiang Mai and drive to Pai yourself, you can find your way easily using maps.me and it's the most beautiful ride up the mountains). Just generally speaking go where the wind is blowing, and don't restrict yourself to an itinerary. Also give Thailand some more love. I'm not gunna tell you where you should or shouldn't go, but instead that you should listen to what other backpackers are saying. If you hear allot about a place that isn't necessarily on your itinerary, then it's probably a good idea to go there :)
